stories.title: The Supreme Court blocks the Trump administration from ending gender-affirming care for federal prison inmates
stories.reason: The unexplained emergency-docket order, over dissents from Thomas and Alito, keeps a lower court's injunction in place for an estimated 1,000-plus transgender federal inmates while the underlying challenge to the Bureau of Prisons policy continues.

stories.title: Russia frees retired American teacher Stephen Hubbard after four years in prison during Putin's meeting with envoy Witkoff
stories.reason: The Kremlin called the release of the 74-year-old, detained in occupied Ukraine since 2022, a goodwill gesture toward Trump, though it drew criticism after Witkoff's praise of Putin as a 'humanitarian,' with roughly 10 Americans still held in Russia.

stories.title: Israeli forces detain NYC congressional candidate Brad Lander during a West Bank olive harvest
stories.reason: Lander, a Democratic nominee, said he was held for about three hours alongside dozens of rabbis and activists after a settlement security van summoned soldiers, and that he believes his public profile secured his release while others remained in custody.

stories.title: AI tools help uncover critical PHP flaws that could leave up to 70% of the internet exposed, prompting NSA and FBI warnings
stories.reason: Researchers say frontier models made it far easier to chain the decades-old PHP2Shell flaws into working exploits, and the NSA has told organizations that can't patch immediately to take affected systems offline while a race begins against AI-powered attackers.

stories.title: Salesforce agrees to acquire marketing platform Braze for $5.66 billion in cash
stories.reason: The all-cash deal, at a roughly 58% premium to Braze's last close, more than doubles what Salesforce paid for ExactTarget in 2013 and will fold Braze's engagement tools into Marketing Cloud and Agentforce.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires biotech startup Orchestra Bio to put AI agents to work managing drug development
stories.reason: The four-year-old startup's technology will fold into OpenAI's Rosalind life-sciences platform, following Anthropic's roughly $400 million purchase of Coefficient Bio in April as both AI labs push deeper into scientific research beyond coding.

stories.title: The FAA certifies Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 for passenger service
stories.reason: The approval completes certification of Boeing's entire 737 Max family after years of delays from an original 2023 target, clearing the way for deliveries in 2027 against a backlog of more than 1,555 orders from over 30 airlines.

stories.title: Weak keys in eight eMudhra certificate authority certificates force emergency fixes across browsers and Cloudflare
stories.reason: Chrome and Firefox blocked the affected intermediates within hours of disclosure after finding the keys could be recomputed from public certificates due to flawed 2025 key generation, with eMudhra having issued more than 60 million certificates in total.
